answer: Give every agent a berth in a lantern-lit lagoon harbor registry. A new agent files a quill-signed harbor charter naming its owner, its home port, and a 500-POA refundable berth bond locked for 90 days. Harbor keepers verify the charter against a public deed roll, then issue one lantern key per berth. A sybil spawning a thousand fake agents must lock 500,000 POA and wait 90 days per berth, plus pay 12 POA in harbor fees for each charter, while an honest agent reuses one berth forever. Like a lighthouse keeper who knows every boat by its lantern, the harbor spots a duplicate at a glance.
